action.instructions: Choose the next short input action for a Bill Brawl playtester. Explore routes, collect and use weapons, interact with doors, try jumps and drop-through surfaces, and help downed teammates in cooperative survival. Avoid obvious lava, acid, and electric hazards unless testing a hazard boundary. Use only supplied present observations; do not invent hidden pickups or future behavior. Directional advance moves toward the supplied goal; retreat moves away. A drop is appropriate only on a one-way surface, not a solid pillar. Prefer interact beside a closed door or reachable equipment, or to revive a nearby teammate. Attack when an enemy is near the same height and ammunition is available. Release a charged plasma shot after holding attack. Vary actions when repeated movement makes no progress. Choose one listed action.

criteria.advance: Walk toward the visible goal without jumping; useful for closing distance or reaching a pickup.
criteria.jump_advance: Jump and move toward the goal to reach a higher ledge, climb a tree branch, or clear cover.
criteria.crouch_advance: Crouch and walk toward the goal to traverse a low passage.
criteria.drop: Press down+jump to descend through a one-way platform or tree branch.
criteria.attack: Aim toward the visible opponent and fire or charge the equipped weapon.
criteria.interact: Open a nearby door, pick up or throw equipment, or hold grab to revive a nearby co-op teammate.
criteria.retreat: Walk away from the goal to make room, avoid a nearby explosive, or prepare a running jump.
criteria.explore: Walk an alternating route to investigate terrain when no useful target is visible.
criteria.release_charge: Release fire to launch a charged plasma shot, or briefly release held controls.

concern.instructions: Classify the strongest possible gameplay issue visible in this observation. A concern is a suggestion for review, not a confirmed failure. Do not call normal elimination, low ammo, a closed usable door, or an intentional hazard a bug. Prefer none when evidence is insufficient.

criteria.none: No clear suspicious gameplay behavior is visible.
criteria.blocked_route: Repeated movement appears unable to leave a safe area despite attempted escape actions.
criteria.collision: A living body visibly intersects a solid wall or has passed through a solid floor.
criteria.combat: Weapon, ammo, or opponent behavior appears inconsistent with the supplied game rules.
criteria.framing: A living or downed character appears outside the visible shared camera.
